method: Viewed all twelve original PPM images in one contact sheet after checking each original hash. Each RGB pixel is enlarged 3x using nearest-neighbor sampling; labels are outside image pixels. Original files are retained without modification.
observations: All twelve images contain the expected sphere or mannequin scene; no blank or corrupt frame was observed.
Hard-light scenes show narrower highlights and sharper shadow boundaries than their soft-light counterparts. Key-only, fill-only and rim-only scenes remain distinct.

The oblique mannequin view, darker isolated exposure and white-balance variants are visibly distinct. The 3200K balance produces a cool rendering of the 5600K key/fill, consistent with the scene settings; the fixture name warm is not interpreted as an observed warm cast.
The emitter-roll fixture preserves the upright mannequin and changes the light shading; the source JSON rotates the rectangular emitter, not the camera.
limits: Qualitative synthetic fixture inspection only; no physical calibration, material fidelity or photographer validation claim.
These study images provide no native app layout, accessibility, Metal execution or PDF export acceptance.
